set.body: Acceptance criteria: after the golden ASC or CSV workflow stabilizes the normalized model, ingest BIDS eye-tracking TSV plus JSON sidecars against an explicitly named BIDS 1.11.x schema; preserve unknown metadata; map timestamp, coordinate-system, eye, screen, calibration, pupil, validity, and asynchronous event metadata without silently inventing values; accumulate diagnostics; round-trip retained metadata where supported; validate fixtures with the designated BIDS validator version. This work does not block the trust epic or v1.0 unless the roadmap is explicitly changed.
set.title: v1.1: versioned BIDS 1.11 eye-tracking ingest
